title: The Asset of Vienna
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Sebastian Lockridge, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
